ESCENA 1 — LA ESTACIÓN VACÍA
ELENA: Aún recuerdo aquella tormenta de nuestra infancia.
JORGE: No va a ocurrir otra vez.
(Suena una campanilla una sola vez.)
ELENA: Alguien ha llegado.
(Empieza a oírse lluvia contra las ventanas.)
JORGE: Cierra bien la puerta.
(La lluvia continúa con la misma intensidad.)
ELENA: Esperaremos aquí.
(La lluvia cesa.)
(Silencio absoluto.)
TELÓN.

SCENE 1 — PLATFORM NINE
(A crackling station announcement starts over a loudspeaker.)
MAYA: The train is late again.
LIAM: I still remember the thunder from last winter.
(The announcement continues at the same level.)
MAYA: That is our platform.
(A metal door slams shut.)
LIAM: That sounded close.
(The announcement is switched off.)
BLACKOUT.

SCÈNE 1 — LE SALON
LOUISE : J'ai rêvé que les cloches sonnaient.
(Une horloge tinte deux fois.)
PAUL : Nous sommes en retard.
(Le tic-tac de l'horloge continue sans changement.)
LOUISE : Écoute.
(La pièce devient silencieuse.)
FIN.

CENA 1 — A CASA
(Um trovão estronda ao longe.)
ANA: A janela ficou aberta.
RUI: Ontem falámos durante horas sobre tempestades.
(O eco do trovão desaparece.)
ANA: Vamos entrar.
(Começa uma música suave no rádio.)
(A música continua.)
FIM.

SZENE 1 — DAS LABOR
ANNA: Früher hörten wir immer Musik.
BEN: Aber heute nicht.
(Ein Glas zerbricht auf dem Boden.)
ANNA: Was war das?
BEN: Nichts mehr bewegen.
(Völlige Stille.)
ENDE.

SCENE 1 — FOYER
ACTOR: Did you hear the word ding?
(A bell dings once at the foyer entrance.)
ACTOR: That was our cue.
(The last bell sound is only being discussed.)
SCENE 2 — GARDEN
ACTOR: It is quiet here.
ACTOR: We use the same bell in both scenes.
(A different bell dings once outside.)
ACTOR: The timing matters.
END.

SCENE — THE INTERVIEW
A: Are you ready?
B: I think so.
A: We could play music later, but not now.
B: I remember the rain outside yesterday.
A: The stage directions contain no sound at all.
(They look at one another.)
END.
